facts.business: McLeod Russel India Limited is engaged in tea plantation and manufacturing operations.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure incurred for Tea Plantation

guidance_or_targets.statement: Monetisation of certain assets including investment in Equity shares of Eveready Industries India Limited by 31st March 2027 as per resolution plan approved by NARCL

key_risks: Debt restructuring and dependency on lenders' approval for resolution plan
Going concern uncertainty due to sustained losses and negative net worth
Asset monetisation execution risk for tea estates and investments
High finance costs and debt burden impacting profitability
Regulatory and compliance risks in tea plantation operations
facts.related_party_note: Loans to promoter group companies (Williamson Magor & Co. Limited, Babcock Borsig Limited, Williamson Financial Services Limited, Woodside Parks Limited) and advances to Managing Director Aditya Khaitan disclosed as related party transactions.
